# Write It Down

> Write It Down is a writing room that makes you keep typing: stop for eight seconds and the draft is deleted. It runs free in the browser and as a Mac app.

Write It Down is made by Trefoil Studio. A session starts on the first keystroke. Deleting, pasting, cutting, and undo are blocked, so the only way forward is to write the next word. The web room lasts sixty seconds. The Mac app lets you choose a session from one to thirty minutes and includes 3 free writing sessions before a license is required.

Who it is for: people who edit instead of finishing, anyone who needs a first draft under pressure, and writers who want a quiet room with no account, no cloud storage, and no draft recovery. There is nothing to configure and no prompt to follow. You either keep writing or you lose the draft.

No draft is saved or sent. The web room keeps the writing in the browser tab. The Mac app keeps it in memory and never uploads it. The only browser storage is your light or dark appearance preference.

See the Mac page for current purchase details and license delivery. The price and refund terms are on that page.
